source.question: How are attendance, appointment completion, and actual treatment fulfillment kept separate?

scope.label: SCOPE / attendance, fulfillment, follow-up
scope.meaning: Separates appointment states from external clinical facts.

version.label: VERSION / immutable Plan revision
version.meaning: A verified external fact is projected into a new revision.

legend.solid: Explicit request, verification, or projection path
legend.dashed: Waiting boundary for an external fact; used only with the legend

nodes.label: Final State Decision
nodes.source: article design: explicit terminal outcome node

edges.kind: attendance, progress, and appointment completion result
payload, schema, signature, and source-version verification
project new Plan revision and follow-up work

decision.label: Final State Decision
decision.rule: Record exactly one of the four external fulfillment outcomes.

budgetRationale: The four contract-defined external fact outcomes remain separate below the final decision, so the sequence branch budget is explicitly widened.

repairs.reason: Keep scope and version above the main frame without covering nodes.
Align every connector start and end with real node boundaries.
Use one rounded orthogonal connector geometry.
Match every arrowhead fill to its connector color.
Reserve independent space between call lines and labels.
Replace an implicit terminal rail with a named decision node and four outcomes.
Leave sufficient bottom padding below the outcome cards.
Route the connectors below the final decision through rounded orthogonal bends and enter each outcome card vertically.
Increase the outcome code, detail, and next-action type so the cards remain readable at full PNG size.
Show a labeled fan-out origin and shared bus below the final decision so outcome connectors do not appear to start in empty space.
Align the shared bus with all four outcome-card centers and use the same rounded entry plus vertical segment for every branch.
Remove the shared bus and route each outcome independently from a distinct final-decision port through rounded orthogonal turns into its card center.
